$comment: Committed snapshot of the canonical Stripe catalog (packages/stripe-seed/catalog.mjs, derived from the founder-locked pricing contracts). The catalog.test.ts drift guard asserts this equals catalog.mjs AND that amounts match the pricing contracts, so the three can never silently diverge. seed.mjs creates these Products + Prices idempotently by lookupKey; set the listed envVars (the resulting price ids) in Vercel after seeding. Amounts are integer USD cents.
